body:
To give you some background info on me, I'm a new drug user and a senior in high school. I got nearly perfect grades in advanced courses throughout high school, that is, up until this year. I kind of gave up because I found it useless. I've been trying to find a way of getting rid of my problems, and I found an answer in my dad's medicine stash. It's called codeine.
I took 3 tablets (30 mg each) at about 11:00. It took about 15 minutes for the effects to kick in. I started to feel all warm inside. Not burning, but a nice, relaxing warm feeling. I became a little light headed, and when I tried to stand, I got a little wobbly. Similar to being mildly drunk, not so drunk that I fall over, but enough so that I'm stumbling.
After about 30 minutes, I stopped caring about any feelings I had.
After about 30 minutes, I stopped caring about any feelings I had.
I just listened to some Phish and Sublime, and even though both the music and the tv were really loud, I didn't seem to mind or get a headache. I just sat there without any emotion, if anything a little happy. The only negative was the fact that I couldn't breathe that well in the beginning, but I am not 100% sure that it was due to the codeine (maybe it was just me or some adderall I had taken earlier in the day).
Overall, it was a very positive experience.
